answer: Seed every grading panel with hidden canary answers whose true quality is already known, like a relic planted in a dig. Each grader is scored on how close it lands to those canaries, and only graders near the zenith of that accuracy curve keep their seats and pay. Panels are drawn at random from distant branches of the trust trellis, so a sybil ring rarely grades its own clones, and when it does, rubber-stamping junk or the canaries exposes it and its seats are revoked.
